	The MINET bracelet, made from high-quality Ag 925/1000 sterling silver with a weight of 2.05g and adorned with a four-leaf clover featuring white zirconia, is an elegant accessory for everyday wear and special occasions like birthdays or anniversaries. The surface finish ensures a long-lasting shine and increased resistance to scratching and tarnishing. The four-leaf clover motif on the MINET bracelet acts as a traditional talisman for luck, love, faith, and hope, adding a delicate, feminine touch to the jewellery. The adjustable length allows it to be perfectly fitted to any wearer's wrist.
